REAL DATA: World Bank PIP API (api.worldbank.org/pip/v1/pip) Barbados 2016 BSLC: Gini 0.3407, median $15.49/day per capita (2017 PPP$), consumption-based.
Method: per-adult median = 15.49*30.42*(100/82.8 15+ pop share, WB SP.POP.0014.TO.ZS) = ~$570/mo; lognormal sigma=0.623 from Gini; percentiles = median*exp(sigma*z).
Wealth: UBS Global Wealth Databook end-2022 (Wikipedia list): Barbados median $31,436, mean $91,291 per adult -> lognormal sigma=sqrt(2*ln(mean/median))=1.459.
indicators.* follow the DB verified-anchor structure (posttax=income; pretax x1.016-1.114; consumption x0.917-0.717; labor x0.6-0.9).
Caveat: PIP Gini is consumption-based, slightly understates income inequality; p90 may be a touch low.

REAL DATA: Bermuda Census 2016 (gov.bm Income report; Royal Gazette 15 May 2018 analysis): median household income $93,713, mean $131,074 -> mean/median 1.399 -> lognormal sigma=sqrt(2*ln 1.399)=0.819.
Bermuda LFS Nov 2022 cross-check: median gross annual income from main job $65,725 (gov.bm) - consistent with household figures.

Method: per-adult median = 93,713/2.09 adults-per-household (2.55 persons/hh x ~82% adults) /12 = $3,737/mo 2016$; CPI +25% to 2024 = $4,670 nominal; PPP haircut x0.82 for Bermuda price level well above US average -> ~$3,830/mo.
Wealth: no UBS coverage; US anchor wealth shape scaled x1.25 (GDP pc PPP $118,728 WB 2024 vs US ~$86k, tempered for expat renter share).
Bermuda has no income tax on capital (payroll-tax system only), so pretax/posttax gap kept small per DB convention.
FLAG: US-shape x0.22 scaling replaced with real census anchors.

REAL DATA: US Census Bureau 2020 Island Areas Census (income year 2019): median household income $28,352, mean $41,752, per-capita $8,425 (census.gov press releases CB23-CN.15 / 2024 cross-tabulations).

Method: mean/median 1.473 -> lognormal sigma=0.880; per-adult median = 28,352/3.20 adults-per-household (household size ~5.0 x 63.9% adult share from census age cohorts) /12 = $738/mo 2019$; CPI +21% to 2024; PPP ~par (low rents offset expensive imports) -> ~$890/mo.
Wealth: no survey exists (customary land cannot be sold); US anchor wealth shape scaled x0.22, matching the income ratio.
indicators.* follow DB verified-anchor structure.
